milestone: M8.1 (track M8 — THE IPHONE PASS, opened 2026-11-10)
intent: The user pointed at FoundPhone-Studio (github.com/keoyyo85/foundphone-studio — an iPhone 15 Pro / iOS 18 virtual-phone story framework, cloned for reference at /tmp/foundphone-studio) and asked for the phone to have 'the same iphone interface', with the plan broken into milestones that each end in a checkpoint so sessions can compact and regroup continuously. Track decision recorded in docs/GAME-PLAN.md M8 (best practices adopted: device metrics as constants, token-layer CSS, pure layout logic + tests, code-drawn icons, one-file-per-app; NOT adopted: their story engine, IndexedDB, 49-app catalog, authoring UI — blackglass's engine + signal desk and the cgAI_ localStorage canon stay). M8.1 delivered the device shell: an iOS token layer on the iPhone 15 Pro grid with the per-phone glassOS theme riding above it, the status bar in iOS glyph grammar (time · island · signal/wifi/battery, diegetic mute + power + bell kept), and a dynamic island that floats above every overlay like real hardware.
scope_delivered: src/engine/os/ios/tokens.css (new) — the iOS base token layer: dark-mode system palette, system-font stack, iOS ease; the screen is a SIZE CONTAINER and island/status metrics are written in cqw (1 logical point = 100/393 cqw) so the top band stays proportionally true at every rendered width — desk stage, POV full-bleed, in between; island z-60 (hardware above every overlay, pointer-inert so the shade's pull-down strip owns its area); reduced-motion static; desktop stage media (≥900px) renders an aspect-true screen (393:852, min-height 640)
src/engine/os/ios/metrics.ts (new) — IOS_DEVICE (393×852, safe 59/34, island 124×36) + IOS_HOME_GRID (4×6 + dock) for the M8.2 launcher math

src/engine/os/Device.tsx — StatusBar rebuilt in iOS grammar (tabular clock in the system font; mute/power/bell kept with their canon aria-labels 'Mute sound'/'Lock the phone'/'Notifications'; code-drawn signal/wifi/battery SVGs replace the ••••/⌃/emoji set; battery % numeral retired — the level paints the glyph fill); DynamicIsland component (bell-slash when muted, via the sound.ts store, data-state attribute API for M8.3 expansions); frame/screen corner radii to iPhone proportions (3.25rem/2.75rem); screen min-height 640 / max 800; shade pull-down strip widened to the island area
src/engine/os/Stage.tsx — MuteToggle resized via the os-ctl token class (canon behavior unchanged)
src/index.css — top safe-area paddings clear the island (home 3.75rem, app/shade/moment 3.5rem); .os-safe-status rule retired
No changes to: app surfaces (M8.4), lock/home layout (M8.2), shade mechanics (M8.3), hub/desk, score/storage, content
constraints_held: No new external assets — every glyph is code-drawn SVG; no Apple fonts/SF Symbols/bitmaps (FoundPhone's BRAND_NOTICE is the model, noted in the token header)
UI-as-character: ink follows --os-ink (per-phone theme) for the status row; the theme layer rides above the iOS base
Smoke-visible contracts held: 'Lock the phone' / 'Notifications' / 'Mute sound' aria-labels, pull-down shade, gestures, returning lock, desk rails, toasts
11px floor: status text is 3.82cqw — ≥11px at every supported screen width (desktop floor 295px → 11.3px, POV ≥360 → 13.7px)
cgAI_ storage untouched; lazy boundaries hold; no commit/push/deploy without explicit authorization
acceptance_results: Island + status row verified rendered on the desk stage (1280×900) and POV (360×780) via /tmp/m81-probe.mjs screenshots (/tmp/m81-2c-desktop-home.png, /tmp/m81-5-pov-home.png): clock left, island centered, control+glyph cluster right, all inside the island columns; the island floats above the moment overlay like hardware
Desktop stage is aspect-true: the phone renders on the 393:852 grid (~310-370px wide depending on window height) and reads as an iPhone on the desk; desk rails (case file + signal desk) unaffected
tsc clean; 76/76 tests; build green (precache 45 entries); assets budget Σ 3.7 MB no duplication
8/8 smokes exit 0 zero console errors: os, resume, shade, anthology (full 5-anchor playthrough — the shell regression net), hub, exam, radar, finale
decisions: Island layering: hardware floats ABOVE all overlays (moment/shade/call) — a real island never scrolls under chrome; it is pointer-inert so the pull-down strip still works
Top-band metrics in cqw against the 393 grid (container-type: size on .os-skin) instead of fixed px — proportional truth at every width, and the narrow-viewport special-casing disappears
Status text rides BELOW env(safe-area-inset-top) so real-device hardware never overlaps it; the CSS island sits at env + 2.8cqw (in browser tabs env=0)
Battery % numeral left the status bar (iOS grammar); the level still paints the glyph fill
Meridiem left the status row (lock screen keeps it) — iOS clocks show time only
Prior work record archived at docs/work/blackglass-operator-console.json (M6.7 wrapup/complete, deployed=false — commit+deploy still awaiting explicit authorization)
artifacts: /tmp/m81-0-select.png … /tmp/m81-5-pov-home.png (probe pass: select, rack, lock, moment with island above, app, home on both stages)
